summary: The source caps n at 10^15, so generating every legal special palindrome through the guaranteed 17-digit successor examines a fixed universe of only 6,986 distinct half permutations.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is an integer from 0 through 10^15, so candidates through 17 decimal digits suffice

replacement_checks.evidence: Every valid pattern uses a subset of even digits 2, 4, 6, 8 and at most one odd digit 1, 3, 5, 7, 9; the multinomial counts across all patterns of length at most 17 sum to 6,986.
Authored cases cover n = 0, strict advancement from an already special number, values around candidate boundaries, large inputs, and the maximum legal n = 10^15.
